description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component, then mounts the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' using React 18's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM.
